metadata.title: NovaPharm Medicines Intelligence Continuation Requirements Ledger
metadata.notes: This supplementary ledger preserves the historical 5,900-record master matrix while making the later medicines-intelligence continuation independently traceable. Repository completion never means staging or production activation.

requirements.title: Research and source-of-truth gate
requirements.summary: Official source ownership, access method, coverage, cadence, lag, licence, caveats and provenance are governed for 32 sources; live discovery evidence is retained separately from ingestion evidence.
requirements.remainingAction: Repeat source review at each release and obtain managed-environment acceptance before treating any source as production operational.

requirements.title: Core NHSBSA CKAN integration
requirements.summary: The server-side CKAN client discovers package resources at runtime, validates response envelopes and content types, applies bounded retries and timeouts, detects periods and revisions, and never exposes an upstream secret to the browser.
requirements.remainingAction: Deploy scheduled discovery and ingestion with private raw storage, checkpoints, monitoring and operator acceptance.

requirements.title: EPD as the primary England prescribing fact
requirements.summary: The complete June 2026 national EPD publisher resource is accepted in the isolated local private cloud: 18,374,449 input and accepted rows, zero rejected or duplicate rows, exact source hash, contiguous source positions, valid lineage digests and source-aware unidentified-row semantics.
requirements.remainingAction: Expand historical EPD only after a fresh encrypted-storage capacity gate, then repeat exact reconciliation and managed-environment acceptance; one complete month is not production or a historical backfill.

requirements.title: Required medicine filter and search system
requirements.summary: Protected search resolves current canonical BNF identities and the aggregate analytics boundary enforces a combined subset of medicine, chapter, supplier, region, ICB, practice, postcode, period and metric filters. The full owner-specified filter families, progressive disclosure and one-action reset are not yet complete.
requirements.remainingAction: Add the remaining source-supported hierarchy, product, pack, organisation, relative-period, comparison and derived-metric filters; add grouped progressive disclosure and reset; then prove one governed state across table, chart and map after national backfills.

requirements.title: Canonical medicine identity and temporal mapping
requirements.summary: Current, historic and monthly-change BNF releases populate versioned medicine, alias, hierarchy and code-history structures without rewriting historic identity or inferring absent SNOMED and dm+d links.
requirements.remainingAction: Ingest the separately governed BNF/SNOMED and dm+d authorities after source access and mapping review.

requirements.title: PCA as the community dispensing cross-check
requirements.summary: The PCA schema, parser, hierarchy fields and 1,000-row publisher sample are validated, but no complete monthly national PCA fact history or EPD/PCA reconciliation has been accepted.
requirements.remainingAction: Backfill complete PCA periods and publish a governed cross-source reconciliation that preserves prescribing and dispensing as different facts.

requirements.title: Secondary care and hospital-community data
requirements.summary: SCMD pre-change and announced post-July-2026 schema adapters fail closed on drift, but current full SCMD and hospital-community resources are discovery-only and have not been backfilled.
requirements.remainingAction: Validate current full resources and units, backfill provisional/final states separately and add the hospital-community source contract before publication.

requirements.title: Prescriber and organisation master
requirements.summary: The full Prescriber Details file was reduced to a privacy-minimised practice and provider master with 158,381 accepted rows, seven governed rejections, 11,787 practices and no clinician identity in the curated model.
requirements.remainingAction: Reconcile the curated master against production-approved ODS authority and monitor organisation changes by effective period.

requirements.title: DoHS API v3
requirements.summary: A fixed-origin, fixed-path, server-only DoHS v3 client enforces API-key headers, redirects, timeouts and response-size limits; no owner-approved key or live onboarding evidence is present.
requirements.remainingAction: Obtain approved DoHS v3 credentials and terms, place the key in managed secret storage and run exact-environment integration tests.

requirements.title: Registered population and prescribing intensity
requirements.summary: The August 2026 totals, age/sex and contemporaneous organisation mapping files were fully reconciled into 6,129 practice totals and 325,811 age/sex rows without patient-level data.
requirements.remainingAction: Deploy monthly ingestion and use these denominators only after accepted prescribing facts are available for the same period and mapping.

requirements.title: Disease prevalence and contextual features
requirements.summary: QOF, population, deprivation and rurality are documented with explicit non-causal limitations, but QOF and contextual feature adapters have not been backfilled into the analytical model.
requirements.remainingAction: Implement versioned QOF, deprivation, rurality and small-area population adapters, then validate geography and temporal joins before model use.

requirements.title: Geography production architecture
requirements.summary: Postcodes are normalised without losing source text, ONS centroid enrichment is fail-closed, historical fields are versionable and Azure SQL geography is the single approved managed spatial authority.
requirements.remainingAction: Provision the approved private Azure SQL geography model and validate temporal boundary and distance queries in staging.

requirements.title: Map experience
requirements.summary: Geocoded practice and pharmacy evidence, real great-circle distance functions, protected tables and a 354,617-row June EPD geography mart exist and reconcile to the accepted national source. Interactive period-aware polygons and map/table parity are not implemented.
requirements.remainingAction: Implement the protected map only from accepted period-aware boundary geometry, retain the accessible table and prove exact map/table agreement and historical-boundary handling.

requirements.title: UK four-nation medicines intelligence
requirements.summary: Official England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland sources and representative schema contracts are governed, but a harmonised four-nation fact backfill and comparability layer do not exist.
requirements.remainingAction: Implement and validate each national adapter, retain source-native definitions and publish only explicitly comparable measures.

requirements.title: England pharmacy-level drug data red-team rule
requirements.summary: The model and UI explicitly prohibit inferring branch-level medicine dispensing from nearby prescribing, aggregate contractor activity, postcode distance or the pharmacy workbook.
requirements.remainingAction: Retain this prohibition in every future fact, map, score, export and AI-answer review.

requirements.title: Analytics warehouse and storage boundary
requirements.summary: Raw immutable, curated versioned and rebuildable mart zones are specified and exercised locally with the complete June EPD resource and exactly reconciled source-scoped marts. Azure SQL and private Blob remain the approved managed authority without creating a second warehouse.
requirements.remainingAction: Provision private Blob and Azure SQL only after cost and environment approval, then rehearse backup, restore and atomic publish.

requirements.title: Minimum data model
requirements.summary: Versioned SQLite and Azure SQL migrations define source, schema, ingestion, medicine, BNF, organisation, practice, pharmacy, geography, prescribing, dispensing, source-scoped marts, forecast, opportunity and campaign entities with lineage. June EPD facts and aggregate marts exercise the local model.
requirements.remainingAction: Exercise historical and managed-database loads, query performance, backup and restore before production acceptance.

requirements.title: Medicine search result owner experience
requirements.summary: Protected current-BNF search and canonical identity detail are implemented with source period, hierarchy, code history and limitations. The Portal can render the accepted June EPD period and source-backed breakdowns after identity selection; absent history, forecasts and opportunities remain explicit.
requirements.remainingAction: Complete the market snapshot, longer trend choices, geography, medicine mix, practice, pharmacy-opportunity, forecasting and methodology sequence only as each underlying national source and model gate is accepted.

requirements.title: Table experience
requirements.summary: The Portal renders accessible, text-led source-health, identity and national one-period analytical tables with visible source/period evidence, server-side pagination, loading, empty and error states. Sorting, column filtering, optional column selection and governed export are not yet implemented.
requirements.remainingAction: Add server-authoritative sorting and column filtering, justify any column chooser, and implement role-governed export only after national fact marts and export authority are accepted.

requirements.title: Forecasting engine
requirements.summary: A deterministic numerical baseline selects between seasonal-naive and Holt-linear models through rolling backtests, reports errors and intervals, prevents temporal leakage, handles sparse history and supports bottom-up reconciliation.
requirements.remainingAction: Run and accept model backtests on complete authoritative medicine histories; no forecast is published before that evidence exists.

requirements.title: Two forecasts, not one
requirements.summary: The documentation separates NHS demand from obtainable NovaPharm sales, but neither an accepted NHS-demand forecast run nor an evidence-backed company-sales model is available.
requirements.remainingAction: Backtest NHS demand on authoritative history and obtain governed internal commercial inputs before implementing a separately labelled NovaPharm sales forecast.

requirements.title: AI analyst
requirements.summary: No AI-generated data, forecast or unsupported answer is exposed; the requested governed natural-language query planner and deterministic evidence response layer are not implemented.
requirements.remainingAction: Implement allowlisted intent resolution over accepted marts, deterministic calculations, concise provenance and explicit refusal when source evidence is absent.

requirements.title: Data quality and red-team rules
requirements.summary: Schema drift, rejected rows, missing mappings, sample-only evidence, identity uncertainty, source semantics and prohibited interpretations remain visible and fail closed.
requirements.remainingAction: Apply the same controls to every future backfill, model run, export and external answer.

requirements.title: Data freshness and automatic update engine
requirements.summary: Idempotent import commands, expected/discovered/ingested period fields and a refresh runbook exist, but no production scheduler, private raw archive, alert route or automated publish is active.
requirements.remainingAction: Deploy the governed scheduler, immutable archive, alerting, checkpoints and operator runbook after infrastructure approval.

requirements.title: Source discovery watch
requirements.summary: Discovery resolves current publisher resources and periods at runtime, retains schema and revision evidence, and does not overwrite successful ingestion timestamps with metadata checks.
requirements.remainingAction: Schedule discovery and route source-change alerts to an accepted production operator.

requirements.title: Import the entire pharmacy workbook with zero data loss
requirements.summary: All 12,936 workbook premises, source rows, original values, 7,211 verified-email rows, 5,725 blank/actioned rows, country totals, provenance and conflicts reconcile without guessed values.
requirements.remainingAction: Obtain owner acceptance of conflicts and import the governed release into private managed storage before operational use.

requirements.title: Canonical pharmacy master
requirements.summary: The model separates premise identity, identifiers, contact evidence, history, source rows, enrichment state and marketing permission instead of treating a spreadsheet row as final authority.
requirements.remainingAction: Reconcile against current four-nation regulator and NHS premises authorities after source licences and adapters are approved.

requirements.title: Pharmacy identity and matching
requirements.summary: Deterministic jurisdiction-specific identifiers take precedence, conflicting registration/contractor evidence is quarantined, shared email never merges branches and fuzzy similarity is review evidence only.
requirements.remainingAction: Resolve the 100 material identity conflicts through authoritative manual review before managed publication.

requirements.title: Automatic four-nation pharmacy refresh
requirements.summary: Four-nation sources and authority boundaries are registered, but complete England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland pharmacy refresh adapters and schedules are not operational.
requirements.remainingAction: Implement, licence and validate each national premise adapter, then schedule temporal reconciliation without overwriting owner evidence.

requirements.title: Email enrichment pipeline
requirements.summary: Contact evidence, verification status, source URL, checked date, confidence, suppression and marketing eligibility are modelled fail closed. A bounded server-only DoHS v3 workflow now requires exact ODS and postcode agreement, rejects stale or malformed observations, writes candidate evidence only under explicit apply authority and never activates marketing eligibility.
requirements.remainingAction: Complete NHS DoHS v3 onboarding, store the issued NHS_DOHS_API_KEY server-side, run a bounded read-only assessment and submit every candidate to human review; never infer mailbox patterns.

requirements.title: Reopen blank-actioned rows only when new evidence exists
requirements.summary: All 5,725 blank/actioned rows remain blank and are queued with an evidence cut-off; a row is not re-presented as resolved without newer source evidence.
requirements.remainingAction: Run governed enrichment only when a new authoritative source observation is available and preserve the prior no-evidence state.

requirements.title: Pharmacy geography and catchments
requirements.summary: Every workbook premise is linked to a normalised postcode and ONS centroid; real 1, 3, 5 and 10 km distance functions are implemented without interpreting distance as dispensing proof.
requirements.remainingAction: Validate managed spatial indexes, historical postcodes, boundary versions and map/table agreement in staging.

requirements.title: Opportunity engine
requirements.summary: A transparent versioned scoring kernel exposes each weighted contribution and fails closed when demand, forecast, product authority, availability or marketing eligibility is absent; no opportunity score has been published.
requirements.remainingAction: Approve weights and commercial gates, backtest against governed outcomes and generate scores only from accepted facts.

requirements.title: Campaign and outreach control
requirements.summary: Campaign, target, suppression and audit entities exist and all imported contacts default to marketing-ineligible, but no approved campaign workflow, export permission or sending integration is active.
requirements.remainingAction: Obtain legal purpose and subscriber-type approval, implement suppression/export controls and connect an authorised sending workflow only after review.

requirements.title: Commercial feedback loop
requirements.summary: The opportunity model anticipates versioned outcomes, but no CRM authority, customer response data, conversion evidence or operational feedback loop is connected.
requirements.remainingAction: Define the approved CRM/outcome authority, retention and feedback semantics before implementing model calibration or performance claims.

requirements.title: Repository continuation gate
requirements.summary: The existing branch, HEAD, dirty worktree, origin/main and Node 24 toolchain were verified and preserved before medicines work; no reset, stash, clean, merge or deployment occurred.
requirements.remainingAction: Record the final candidate SHA only after the dirty worktree is intentionally committed and exact-SHA checks run.

requirements.title: Backend boundary
requirements.summary: Upstream clients, raw imports, analytics queries and pharmacy contacts remain server-side; PUBLIC_ONLY contains none of the protected intelligence and client roles cannot access board/admin services.
requirements.remainingAction: Repeat gateway, bundle and role-isolation tests against managed staging and the exact deployed SHA.

requirements.title: Recommended implementation sequence
requirements.summary: Source truth, contracts, migrations, controlled imports, identity, geography, models, service, Portal views, documentation and tests were implemented in dependency order without synthesising missing facts.
requirements.remainingAction: Continue the same dependency order for full fact backfills, managed marts, forecasts, opportunities and campaigns.

requirements.title: Routes and modules
requirements.summary: Medicines Intelligence remains governed Portal module executive.nhs-data with overview plus eight subordinate views; the 54-module count is unchanged and unavailable capabilities are not presented as operational.
requirements.remainingAction: Activate the protected routes only in managed FULL_PLATFORM after identity, API and data dependencies pass staging acceptance.

requirements.title: Apple-discipline data UI
requirements.summary: The owner-approved desktop information architecture is implemented as a text-led, neutral, icon-free and read-only protected workspace. The medicine remains unboxed and dominant; filters, metrics, analysis, evidence tables and mobile sequencing use truthful accepted or unavailable states rather than decorative cards, illustrations or copied sample values. Exact local Chromium/WebKit and human visual review are retained.
requirements.remainingAction: Repeat exact-tree browser, accessibility and human visual acceptance against the locally accepted June facts, then repeat exact-SHA acceptance in managed staging; production acceptance remains separate.

requirements.title: Chart requirements
requirements.summary: The accepted June EPD month is presented as a designed one-period state rather than a fabricated trend. Source-backed summary and breakdown tables exist, but an accessible multi-period chart and forecast intervals cannot be accepted from one month.
requirements.remainingAction: Implement directly labelled, unit, period and source-aware charts with accessible equivalents only after at least two accepted periods; retain forecast unavailable until sufficient backtested history exists.

requirements.title: Performance
requirements.summary: Against 18,374,449 accepted national facts, the protected local probe measured 407.15 ms indexed search, 38.04 ms presentation analytics and 3,796.77 ms full Apixaban chemical-substance analytics. Queries retain server-side pagination, bounded history, exact table/series reconciliation and no browser-side raw data or live CKAN calls.
requirements.remainingAction: Prove response, payload, memory, concurrent-user and managed-database budgets in staging; retain the 3.8-second broad chemical query as an optimisation target rather than a production acceptance claim.

requirements.title: Data contract tests
requirements.summary: Contracts cover EPD, PCA, both SCMD variants, Prescriber Details, contractor, pharmacy activity, practice flow, PHS Scotland, NWSSP Wales and BSO Northern Ireland, with identifier and drift safeguards.
requirements.remainingAction: Refresh representative fixtures and contracts whenever a publisher changes a schema; current full-file acceptance remains source-specific.

requirements.title: Pharmacy import acceptance
requirements.summary: The workbook controls reconcile all 12,936 premises, 7,211 verified email rows and 5,725 blank/actioned rows; no guessed emails, group-email branch merges or lost original postcodes were introduced.
requirements.remainingAction: Resolve documented identity conflicts and repeat the same controls for the production-managed import.

requirements.title: Medicine filter acceptance
requirements.summary: The protected API and repository tests prove combined medicine identity, substance, presentation, SNOMED, chapter, supplier, region, ICB, practice, postcode, period and metric filters. A real Apixaban presentation and chemical-substance query against 18,374,449 accepted June facts returns source-period evidence and exact table/series reconciliation. Remaining hierarchy fields and chart/map agreement are not complete.
requirements.remainingAction: Complete BNF section and paragraph fixtures, all required source-supported filters and a shared governed state across table, accessible chart and map after authoritative national backfills.

requirements.title: Search acceptance
requirements.summary: Canonical current-BNF name and code search is server-generated and excludes ended identities, but brand, SNOMED and dm+d acceptance cannot be proved before those separately governed mappings are ingested.
requirements.remainingAction: Ingest approved mapping sources and extend acceptance across generic, brand, chemical code, presentation code and SNOMED identity examples without special cases.

requirements.title: Geography acceptance
requirements.summary: Practice/pharmacy postcode enrichment, a protected period-aware nearby endpoint, real great-circle radius calculations, a text-led Portal result view and a source-reconciled June EPD geography mart are implemented. Interactive ICB geometry, complete historical-boundary semantics and map/table agreement are not complete.
requirements.remainingAction: Add governed period-aware ICB boundary geometry, then prove paginated table and accessible map agreement against accepted national aggregates.

requirements.title: Forecast acceptance
requirements.summary: The forecast kernel proves baseline selection, rolling tests, error metrics, intervals, cut-offs, leakage rejection, sparse fallback, hierarchy reconciliation and non-LLM numeric generation on deterministic fixtures.
requirements.remainingAction: Create and approve an authoritative-data model card and backtest before any forecast is exposed as an accepted analytical output.

requirements.title: Opportunity acceptance
requirements.summary: Transparent scoring and fail-closed eligibility are tested, but high-demand geography, customer/prospect status, verified-contact counts and governed export cannot be proved without demand and commercial authorities.
requirements.remainingAction: Connect approved demand, customer, product, marketing and outcome evidence; backtest weights and add a permissioned export with audit and suppression.

requirements.title: AI acceptance
requirements.summary: No unsupported AI answer is generated; entity resolution, deterministic query planning, source/period calculation provenance and refusal tests for the medicines domain remain unimplemented.
requirements.remainingAction: Implement and test the governed analyst only after the deterministic fact and filter APIs are complete.

requirements.title: Security and privacy
requirements.summary: Server-only credentials, board/admin scope, client denial, query limits, immutable lineage, privacy-minimised practice data, marketing fail-closed state and PUBLIC_ONLY exclusion are implemented and tested; no patient identifier is stored.
requirements.remainingAction: Run managed staging penetration, load, export, backup/restore and identity-boundary acceptance before production activation.

requirements.title: Documentation
requirements.summary: All 12 required governed documents exist and distinguish live discovery, file imports, credentials, restrictions, planned adapters, schema alerts, missing backfills and production dependencies.
requirements.remainingAction: Maintain the documents and evidence ledger with each source, code and production-state change.

requirements.title: Ingestion and operational observability
requirements.summary: The protected owner/admin source-health table shows source, expected/discovered/ingested period, status, freshness, run times, schema, rows, quality and next action from persisted evidence rather than hard-coded periods.
requirements.remainingAction: Connect scheduler and alert telemetry in managed staging and prove failed-run visibility and operator routing.

requirements.title: External signals future-proofing
requirements.summary: The source registry and model boundaries permit future versioned signals without adding unapproved scrapers or blocking the core identity platform; none is falsely presented as integrated.
requirements.remainingAction: Add NICE, MHRA, Drug Tariff, shortage or market-entry signals only after a primary-source, licence, schema and analytical-use review.

requirements.title: Final implementation report for the new work
requirements.summary: This machine-validated ledger and its rendered report separate source discovery, adapters, contracts, samples, backfills, scheduling, UI, security, forecasting, deployability and production operation.
requirements.remainingAction: Update lifecycle states only when new exact evidence exists; never collapse them into a single done claim.

lifecycle.detail: 32 governed sources are registered; 17 NHSBSA CKAN packages were checked live with 17 successful discoveries and no failed discovery. Discovery is not ingestion.
Core England, BNF, registered-population and representative four-nation contracts exist; several current national, dm+d, QOF and contextual adapters remain pending.
Implemented source contracts fail closed on missing columns and preserve identifiers as text.
EPD and PCA each have an exact bounded 1,000-row publisher sample validation; this is not a national ingest.
BNF temporal identity and one complete national June 2026 EPD period are accepted locally; prescribing history, dispensing, secondary-care and four-nation fact history are not complete.
Idempotent commands and a runbook exist, but no production scheduler, private archive or alert route is active.

The protected nine-view local UI truthfully presents available identity, pharmacy, population and source-health evidence, keeps unsupported analytical outputs unavailable, and passed the retained Chromium/WebKit responsive and human visual review.
Board/admin service access is enforced server-side; customer access is denied and PUBLIC_ONLY contains no private intelligence.
The numerical kernel is backtest-tested on deterministic fixtures, but no authoritative medicine history has an accepted model run.
The protected application and API build locally with fail-closed absent-data states; exact managed-environment acceptance is still required.
No cost-bearing infrastructure was provisioned and no production deployment is claimed.
Production identity, storage, scheduled ingestion, backfills, monitoring, owner acceptance and real operational use remain unverified.
